name: Konami VRC4a/VRC4c

components.role: VRC4 ASIC with mapper-21 A0/A1 package wiring, 8 KiB PRG banking, 1 KiB CHR banking, CIRAM routing and IRQ control
Reusable Konami VRC 8-bit reload/counter and 341-dot prescaler circuitry

connections: mapper.PrgBank0/1 + PrgMode -> PrgRom bank address inputs
notes: NES 2.0 submapper 1 selects VRC4a wiring and submapper 2 selects VRC4c wiring. Legacy iNES mapper 21 lacks package wiring metadata, so the cartridge package uses the documented VRC4a/VRC4c address-line OR compatibility decode without moving any mapper semantics into the motherboard or compiler.
